timeout.description: Time in seconds to wait for response to requests

use_unique_tor.description: Make requests over Tor with new Tor circuit after each request

folder_output.description: Folder to save output if using multiple usernames

output_file.description: File to save output if using single username

sites.description: List of site names to limit analysis to. If empty, check all sites.

local_only.description: Force the use of the local data.json file

print_all.description: Output sites where the username was not found

print_found.description: Output sites where the username was found

browse.description: Browse to all results on default browser

verbose.description: Display extra debugging information and metrics

usernames.description: One or more usernames to check with social networks
